⚠️ Blocked on Android 13+? How to unlock

When installing an APK outside the Play Store, Android blocks Notification Access by default:

1. Tap "Configure Permission" first and tap on MusicWallpaper (a Restricted Setting warning will appear—tap OK).

2. Tap "Open App Info" below, tap the 3 dots (⋮) in the top-right corner, and select "Allow restricted settings".

3. Return here and enable "Configure Permission" normally!

MusicWallpaper is completely free, open-source, and ad-free. If you enjoy using it and would like to buy me a coffee to help keep updates coming, any contribution is hugely appreciated!
1. How do I keep the last album cover on my Lockscreen without keeping it on my Home Screen?

Enable both \"Keep last album cover when paused\" and \"Show music artwork on Lockscreen only\". Then pick your preferred static Home Screen photo and apply MusicWallpaper to \"Home and lock screens\". The last cover stays active only on the Lockscreen even after music stops.
2. Why can\'t I enable \"Use diffused album blur on Home Screen\" and \"Show music artwork on Lockscreen only\" at the same time?

Both toggles control different Home Screen behaviors while music is playing:
• Diffused album blur: fills your Home Screen with a soft blur of the current album and returns to its standby photo when music stops.
• Lockscreen only: always keeps your chosen static photo on the Home Screen.
Each option has its own independent photo picker.
3. My device already lets me apply Live Wallpapers to the Lockscreen only. Do I need \"Show music artwork on Lockscreen only\"?
No. That option is only for devices/ROMs that don\'t allow applying Live Wallpapers exclusively to the Lockscreen. If your phone lets you set it on the Lockscreen alone, leave this toggle off.
4. Android blocked Notification Access with \"Restricted setting\". How do I unlock it?

On Android 13+, sideloaded APKs have Notification Access restricted by default.

Option A — On your phone:
1. Tap "Configure Permission" and select MusicWallpaper (tap OK on the warning).
2. Open App Info, tap the 3 dots (⋮) in the top-right corner, and select "Allow restricted settings".
3. Return and enable MusicWallpaper normally.

Option B — Via ADB (PC or Shizuku/Termux):
adb shell appops set com.lucasvinicius.musicwallpaper2 ACCESS_RESTRICTED_SETTINGS allow

adb shell cmd notification allow_listener com.lucasvinicius.musicwallpaper2/com.lucasvinicius.musicwallpaper2.MusicNotificationListener
5. How do I stop YouTube, Reels, or browsers from changing my wallpaper?
In Card 1 (Music Detection), tap \"Ignored Apps\" and check any video players, social media apps, or browsers you don\'t want MusicWallpaper to track.
6. Why are some songs static or take a few seconds to update on slow Wi-Fi?

Not all albums have official animated artwork in Apple Music. When unavailable, the app automatically downloads the 1000x1000 static cover or uses your player\'s notification artwork. On slow connections, the previous cover stays smoothly on screen while automatic 2s and 4s checks load the new artwork.
7. Does keeping the animated cover on pause or using Home Screen Diffusion drain a lot of battery?

No. Both the video decoder (ExoPlayer) and GPU blur passes automatically pause whenever the screen turns off. On the Home Screen with Diffusion enabled, the crossfade lasts 260ms and video playback pauses right after, keeping battery usage virtually zero.
8. Why doesn\'t \"Dynamic System Colors (Material You)\" show up on my phone?

This feature is exclusively enabled on Google Pixel 7 or newer devices, as it relies on Pixel\'s native Material You lockscreen color engine (with a strict 60-second cooldown to protect CPU performance).
